reason: They want the item price and their fee paid before anything ships, to a name I have never heard of, and then I wait two or three weeks. I only pay when the thing is in my hand, so I would save the post and wait to see if people I know get their orders.
objection: Paying up front to a new page and then waiting weeks. If the page disappears, my money is gone and nobody gives it back.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery, paying everything at my door, or a relative or neighbour who has ordered from them several times and got their things.
